issue.title: bug with styleUrls in component configuration

body: This was reported again in #6905, anyone know if this is a bug or a feature? and if so, why and how should I handle this?
Still seems to be an issue in 2.0.0-beta.11

My workaround is to start my absolute path with the two dots parent directory.

styleUrls: ["/poster-manager-app/asset-management/asset-management.component.css"] // does not work
styleUrls: ["../poster-manager-app/asset-management/asset-management.component.css"] // DOES work by adding "../"

NOTE: this is my temporary workaround which in some cases won't work, for more details please read @diestrin comment below.

I hope it helps

Hi @diestrin, thanks it makes sense what you said. It solves the problem for my needed until we understand if it is a bug or not. Anyway for my comment I added a note to read your comment since that "workaround" won't work in same cases.
@rocco-scaramuzzi 's solution seems to work, but this kinda sucks.

issue.title: [Dart] CSS @import not behaving as documented (TS)
issue.body:
The Dart equivalent of the [Dev Guide Component Styles example](https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/guide/component-styles.html), doesn't behave like its TS counterpart when it comes to CSS `@import`s. **Steps to reproduce and a minimal demo of the problem** I will post a URL to the Dart sources in a followup comment to this issue (as soon as I can). In the meantime, the relevant files are: - `lib/hero_details_componet.dart`: > ``` dart > @Component( > selector: 'hero-details', > template: ..., > styleUrls: const ['hero_details_component.css'], /*<<<<<<<*/ > directives: const [HeroTeamComponent]) > class HeroDetailsComponent { > @Input() Hero hero; > } > ``` - `lib/hero_details_componet.css` (excerpt): > ``` css > @import 'hero_details_box.css'; /*<<<<<<<*/ > :host { > display: block; > border: 1px solid black; > } > ... > ``` **Current behavior** An attempt at doing a **`pub build` fails** with the error: ``` nocode Building component_styles... Build error: Transform StylesheetCompiler on component_styles|lib/hero_details_component.css threw error: Url component_styles|lib/hero_details_component.css.dart is not a valid asset: url ``` Replacing the `@import` target with other values yields the given results: - `@import 'foo.css'` - pub build error (as described above). - `@import '/foo.css'` - gets **web/foo.css** and the CSS for - normal selectors work, but - **ng special selectors** like `:host` **do not work**. - `@import '/packages/component_styles/foo.css'`
gets **lib/foo.css** and the CSS has the same issues as `@import '/foo.css'`. **Expected/desired behavior** According to the [Dev Guide Component Styles, CSS @imports subsection](https://angular.io/docs/ts/latest/guide/component-styles.html#css-imports): > We can also import CSS files into our CSS files by using the standard CSS @import rule. > In this case the URL is relative to the CSS file into which we are importing. **Other information** This was tested with **beta.17**. Possibly related (but different) issues: - CSS @import with root path "/" bug #6449 - Transformer does not work well with web urls #2607 - styleUrls does not work with root path "/" #4974
